name: PageFly
description:
PageFly is the Shopify page builder behind 320+ page and section templates, rated 4.9 from nearly 5,900 reviews on the Shopify App Store and carrying Shopify's Built for Shopify badge. This connector lets Claude work directly on a connected store's PageFly pages.

Claude can list and inspect existing pages, search the PageFly template library and help center, and browse the store's own product photos and uploaded media — then author entirely new sections in PageFly's native element vocabulary, preview them rendered inside the live theme, and publish once the merchant approves.

It also surfaces the store's page-health scan, CRO checkup findings and A/B test results, so Claude can explain what is hurting conversion and then fix it in place rather than just describing the problem.

Key features: 
•  Build complete landing pages from a brief, using the store's real products and images 
•  Edit or replace a single section without rebuilding the page 
•  Preview on the live theme before anything goes public 
•  Publish and unpublish to the storefront
•  Read page health, CRO findings and A/B test results 
•  Search 320+ page and section templates, and the PageFly help center

Access is scoped to the one Shopify store the merchant approves inside their own Shopify admin. Pages are created unpublished and never reach the storefront until publish is explicitly called. The connector reads no customer, order or payment data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PageFly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PageFly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://apps.pagefly.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PageFly MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PageFly lists 16 MCP tools, including add_section, create_page, create_upgrade_link, get_ab_test_results, get_cro_findings, get_page, get_page_authoring_guide, get_page_health, get_plan_status, list_pages, list_shop_media, and preview_page.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PageFly?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PageFly in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
PageFly requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PageFly is developed by PageFly. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
